pending.meaning: The record exists and the objects are being written (intake in flight). The intent: nothing is served from it.

quarantined.meaning: Stored in quarantine; the scan could not be completed (scan_failed). Never served. A rescan may tighten it; only a person releases it.

held.meaning: Stored in quarantine and waiting for a person (needs_sandbox, the form holds). Never served until released.

released.meaning: Copied to the released bucket; served as a download only.

blocked.meaning: A block verdict (active content, polyglot, bomb, malware, type mismatch). Kept in quarantine as evidence until retention. It leaves only by deletion: releasing a block is refused until it has its own reviewed signing path.

rejected.meaning: Refused at the edge (size, type): nothing was stored. The record is the evidence until retention, then it becomes a tombstone.

deleted.meaning: The objects are removed; the record stays as a tombstone (hash, verdict, deleted_at).

actors.human: a person, only as the verified entry of the approval ledger (kit.approval-ledger.v1, ledger <project>:uploads)

intake.effect: record first (pending), then the objects, then the commit to the decided stage

rollback.effect: an interrupted intake: the objects are removed and the record becomes a deleted tombstone

rescan.effect: re-evaluate the quarantined bytes; may only tighten; a released upload that is tightened loses its released object

release.effect: write the released object from verified quarantine bytes, then commit released

delete.effect: remove the objects, then commit deleted

hold.effect: set or clear the retention hold; no object changes

migrate.effect: a record written before keys were derived from the record: copy its objects to the derived keys, verify, commit the record, then the legacy keys are removed once no record uses them

transitions.note: tighten only: a released upload may be withdrawn, never the other way
